# William McKinley Administration (1897–1901)

 Note: The volumes listed below contain at least one document from the period of this presidential administration; view and search within the available documents. The Foreign Relations series was organized by year for the volumes covering 1861–1951, triennially for 1952–1963, and by presidential administration for 1964 onward—with some exceptions.
